newsitem.title: USA: Kmart sells Rite Aid stake.
newsitem.headline: Kmart sells Rite Aid stake.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday it sold its entire 6.9 million share stake in Rite Aid Corp in an overnight underwritten offering, and will receive proceeds of about $260 million at closing.
Morgan Stanley & Co was the underwriter for the transaction, Kmart said.
Kmart said the shares were considered a liquid investment and the decision to sell fit into its strategy to focus on discount retailing.

"As Kmart is a turnaround business focusing on our discount retailing operations, the selling of the shares is consistent with that strategy," Robert Burton, director of investor relations for Kmart, said in a telephone interview.
Kmart shares were down 1/4 at 11-1/8 Thursday and Rite Aid shares were up 1-1/2 at 39-5/8.
